purpose: Offline consecutive recorded images; one reusable CPU detector plan and one image-space tracker
algorithm_changes: No changes to YOLOX-S, four-view merge, vehicle consistency, or standalone tracker math
implementation: Compile the existing independent tracking library sources in this binary; the unchanged ONNX workspace lockfile supplies resolved dependencies
timestamp_s_input: Original decimal seconds as a JSON string; parse with Rust str::parse::<f64>, then validate monotonic clock
preflight: Before model loading, validate every image hash/decoded dimensions, clock, configuration and duplicate identity; retain one RGB image at a time
inference: Read and verify each image again against its declared SHA/dimensions; reuse one model plan across all image events
other_events: missing and failed, with the unchanged tracker semantics
output: One complete bounded report; no overwrite; all raw detector views and tracking snapshots preserved
